claims: CBS and ESPN broadcast the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Paramount+, ESPN+, Masters.com, and the Masters App.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes Featured Groups, Amen Corner, and holes 15 & 16.
CBS handles weekend rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
ESPN covers Thursday-Friday of the 2026 Masters Tournament on TV.
CBS covers Saturday-Sunday of the 2026 Masters Tournament on TV.
Paramount+ and Masters.com offer live coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament including "Masters Live" and specialty feeds.
The Par 3 Contest is Wednesday, April 8.
The Par 3 Contest is available on ESPN, ESPN+, Masters.com, and Disney+.
SiriusXM PGA Tour Radio offers coverage from 2–8 p.m.
Thursday-Friday coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on ESPN is 3 p.m. – 7:30 p.m. ET.
Saturday coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on CBS is 3 p.m. – 7 p.m. ET.
Sunday coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on CBS is 2 p.m. – 7 p.m. ET.
Featured Holes/Groups coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available throughout the day on Masters.com and Paramount+ starting around 8:45 a.m.
